diagnostic_evidence.quote: I_y = \sum_{i \in \Z, j \geq 2} \left(j^2 -\frac{1}{4}\right)  \left\{  \int_{\CC^{i,j}_h} \left\{  \left(j^2 -\frac{1}{4}\right)\left[ \frac{v(x_1,x_2\pm h)}{(x_2\pm h)^2} - \dfrac{v(x_1, x_2)}{x_2^2}\right] - x_2^2 \partial^2_{x_2} \left[\frac{v(x_1,x_2)}{x_2^2}\right] + 2j \left[\frac{v(x_1,x_2+ h)}{(x_2+ h)^2} - \frac{v(x_1,x_2- h)}{(x_2- h)^2} \right] - 4 x_2 \partial_{x_2}\left[\frac{v(x_1,x_2)}{x_2^2}\right] \right\} \dd{\x} \right\}^2

issues.failure_explanation: The bracket of I_y displayed two lines earlier is Σ_±((j±1)²−1/4)F_± − 2(j²−1/4)w − ∂²_{x_2}v with F_± = v(x_2±h)/(x_2±h)² and w = v/x_2². Since ((j±1)²−1/4) = (j²−1/4) ± 2j + 1 and ∂²_{x_2}v = x_2²w'' + 4x_2w' + 2w, the true integrand equals the paper's bracket plus (F_+ + F_- − 2w). The written equality (and the subsequent Taylor display with coefficient [(j²−1/4)h² − x_2²] and remainder weight (j²−1/4)+2j sgn(σ)) therefore omits one copy of the symmetric second difference ∫_C (F_+ + F_- − 2w)dξ, an O(h²)-size quantity that is not small and is never estimated. The equality chain of the proof is thus invalid and the O(h²) estimate (eq:consistency-estimate-first-lapl) is not established by what is written.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Keep the dropped symmetric second difference ∫_C[w(x_2+h)+w(x_2−h)−2w(x_2)]dx in the bracket (i.e. coefficient [(j²+3/4)h²−x_2²] for w'' and an extra −2w term, and (j²+3/4) in the fourth-order remainder), then bound it by the same cellwise Taylor/Cauchy–Schwarz estimates already used (a direct C¹ cell estimate suffices, since the integrand has non-zero average); this only enlarges C^v by M_γ-dominated norms and preserves the stated O(h²) rate.
issues.overall_effect: The O(h²) consistency estimate for the first discrete Laplacian (thm:consistency-first-lapl), its bounded-domain form (rem:1-lapl-bounded-domain), its application to the solution u (rem:consistency-first-laplace-sos), and the semi-discrete/fully-discrete convergence results that consume that consistency estimate lose their supporting argument; the stated O(h²) rate itself remains true and is recoverable.
issues.title: I_y decomposition in the first discrete Laplacian's consistency proof drops a symmetric second difference, so the written equality is false
issues.why_classification: The repair is a local correction of one displayed identity plus a routine cellwise estimate of the restored term of exactly the type already present in the proof; the operator, its rate, and all dependent results survive unchanged.

issues.failure_explanation: Section sec:construction-second-lapl restricts the second discrete Laplacian to Z_1×Z_2 with Z_2 = {1,...,M}, M = ⌊log(D)/h⌋. On the grid (eq:spatial-grid-2) row j sits at height x_2 = e^{jh}, so this node set only covers heights [e^h, e^{Mh}] ⊂ [1, D], while the announced domain is H^2_D = [−D,D]×[1/D,D]: the strip 1/D ≤ x_2 ≤ e^h ≈ 1 of the box carries no node at all, although there u is not small (d_g(O,x) = O(1) for x_2 ≈ 1). With the convention v^h_{i,j}=0 outside Z_1×Z_2, the truncated operator (eq:laplacian-2) drops the vertical neighbour of the bottom row j=1, producing a per-node mismatch of size O(ρ(h)^{-2})·(Π_h u)_{i,0} = O(1)·(Π_h u)_{i,0}, so ‖Δ^{(2)}_{h,D}Π_{h,D}u − Π_{h,D}Δ_g u‖ does not tend to 0 and the estimate claimed in rem:consistency-second-laplace-sos is false for the object as defined. The intended set is the symmetric one {j : e^{jh} ∈ [1/D, D]} — exactly what line 2 of Algorithm alg:theta-heat-hyperbolic selects and what the node counts N×M = 305×73 (i.e. 2M+1 = 73 rows with M = ⌊log 9.52/(1/16)⌋ = 36) in Tables table01–table02 correspond to — so the definition, not the method, is defective.

failure_location.quote: \ell_{h,D}^2\coloneqq\left\{(v^h_{i,j})_{i\in Z_1, j\in Z_2} \in \ell_h^2, \rm{with}~Z_1 = \overline{- N, N}\,, Z_2 = \overline{1, M}\right\}\,,

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Redefine the truncated vertical index set of the second scheme as Z_2 = {j ∈ Z : e^{jh} ∈ [1/D, D]} = {−M',…,M'} with M' = ⌊log(D)/h⌋ (matching Algorithm alg:theta-heat-hyperbolic and the node counts in the tables). The new bottom row borders the tail region H^2 \ H^2_D, so the additional truncation error is bounded by the paper's existing estimates (lem:tail-control, coro:tail-control-heat); no other change is needed and every stated guarantee is recovered.
issues.overall_effect: The consistency remark rem:consistency-second-laplace-sos, the claim that the second truncated operator satisfies (L1)–(L3), and hence the convergence guarantee of Theorem thm:convergence-theta and the O(h²) convergence advertised for the second discrete Laplacian (abstract, Section sec:crac-stix, Section sec:conclusion) are unsupported for the second scheme as constructed; the numerical tables, however, were produced with the symmetric node set.
issues.title: Truncated second discrete Laplacian is defined on the wrong node set, so its consistency estimate fails as constructed
issues.why_classification: A one-line correction of the truncated node set restores the intended scheme; the resulting bottom truncation row is a tail region already covered by the paper's artificial-boundary estimates, so all guarantees are recovered without new arguments.

issues.failure_explanation: After the change of variables σ = s/2 − (α+1/2)√t (which maps s ∈ [0,∞) onto σ ∈ [−(α+1/2)√t, ∞) and contributes the Jacobian ds = 2dσ, dropped in the display), the paper integrates e^{−σ²}[2σ+2(α+1/2)√T]·√(1+[2σ+2(α+1/2)√T]√T) over (−∞,∞) and calls the result C_{α,T}. On σ < −(α+1/2)√T the linear factor is negative and the radicand 1+[2σ+2(α+1/2)√T]√T becomes negative, so the displayed integrand is not real-valued on the claimed domain and the constant C_{α,T} is not defined; the concluding step of the proof of lem:stability-exp(alpha-d) is thus invalid as written, leaving the lemma unproved (its conclusion is standard and is recovered by bounding the sub-linear factor on s ≥ 0, e.g. s√(1+s√T) ≤ C(1+s²T), and using Gaussian moments).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the last display by the elementary bound M ≲ e^{α(α+1)T}∫₀^∞ e^{−(s/2−(α+1/2)√T)²}(s + s²T) ds ≤ C_{α,T} (using √(1+s√T) ≤ C(1+s√T) for s ≥ 0 and Gaussian moments); the lemma then follows with a finite constant and all its applications stand.
issues.overall_effect: Lemma lem:stability-exp(alpha-d) is left without a complete proof; consequently Lemma lem:pseudo-Schwarz-heat, Corollary rem:pseudo-Schwarz-heat-s-confined, Lemma lem:2-relatii, Corollary coro:tail-control-heat and the consistency/regularity steps that invoke them are unsupported until the final estimate is repaired. The lemma's statement is standard and survives.
issues.title: Weighted heat-semigroup stability lemma: final estimate is an ill-defined integral
issues.why_classification: A one-line standard Gaussian-integral bound replaces the broken display; the lemma's statement, its constant type, and every dependent result are preserved with no new argument.
